mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification in development builds

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is performed on all builds, development builds included, and no build type is exempt. This is consistent with the project's recorded requirement that all communication use HTTPS, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
